story:
Ethan's Park Adventure

Ethan loved Saturdays because his family went to the big park. [emotion:QT/happy] He held his mom's hand, feeling excited to play. His little sister, Lily, skipped ahead, carefully carrying her favorite fuzzy squirrel, Squeaky. [emotion:QT/happy] Ethan smiled; he couldn't wait to climb the tall slide that overlooked the whole playground.

They found a picnic blanket near a sturdy oak tree. [gesture:patience] "Let's put Squeaky here, Lily, so he'll be safe," Mom said gently. [gesture:nodding-yes] Lily nodded, placing Squeaky right next to their bag. Then, she ran off towards the swings. Ethan went to the slide, climbing up, up, up! He slid down fast, feeling the wind rush past him.

After a while, Lily ran back to the blanket. [emotion:QT/sad] Her lip quivered. [emotion:QT/sad] "Squeaky is gone!" she cried, her eyes wide. [emotion:QT/afraid] Ethan felt a little nervous because he wanted to play, but Lily was so sad. Mom knelt down. [emotion:QT/calm] "Oh, dear. Maybe he just moved. Where did you last see him, Lily?"

Lily pointed vaguely. "Somewhere near the big red bench?" [emotion:QT/think] Ethan thought for a moment. "I saw you running fast by the flower bushes, Lily. Did Squeaky fall out then?" [emotion:QT/happy] [gesture:nodding-yes] "Yes!" Lily said, feeling a tiny bit hopeful.

[emotion:QT/calm] "Okay," Mom said, "Let's search together. Ethan, you look near the red bench. Lily, check under the flower bushes. We need to be very *helpful* so that we can find him." [emotion:QT/happy] Ethan felt a surge of energy. He walked slowly, looking under benches and behind small shrubs. Lily carefully peeked under the brightly colored flowers.

[emotion:QT/surprised] Suddenly, Ethan saw something brown sticking out from behind a large rock, right next to the tall oak tree. [emotion:QT/surprised] "Lily! Mom! Look!" he called out. [emotion:QT/happy] It was Squeaky! [emotion:QT/happy] Lily ran over, her face breaking into a huge grin. [gesture:embrace] [emotion:QT/happy] She grabbed her squirrel and gave it a big hug. [emotion:QT/happy] "Thank you, Ethan!" she said, feeling so *grateful*.

[emotion:QT/happy] Ethan felt really *proud* because he helped find Squeaky. [emotion:QT/happy] They all sat down on the blanket, happy and *caring* for each other. [emotion:QT/happy] It was a wonderful day at the park, even better than just sliding, because they had worked *together*.

questions.question: Where did Lily first put her fuzzy squirrel, Squeaky, to keep him safe?
questions.correct_answer: She placed Squeaky right next to their picnic bag.
wrong_answers: She put Squeaky under the big red bench.
She left Squeaky by the tall slide.

questions.question: What did Lily do right after Ethan found Squeaky behind the large rock?
questions.correct_answer: Lily ran over and gave Squeaky a big hug.
wrong_answers: Lily went to play on the swings again.
Lily asked Ethan to climb the slide.

questions.question: Why did Lily feel very sad and afraid when she ran back to the blanket?
questions.correct_answer: She felt sad because her favorite fuzzy squirrel was gone.
wrong_answers: She was afraid of the tall slide at the park.
She felt sad because she wanted a snack.

questions.question: How do you think Ethan felt when he found Squeaky near the big oak tree?
questions.correct_answer: Ethan felt very proud and happy because he helped Lily.
wrong_answers: Ethan felt tired and wanted to go home.
Ethan felt surprised and a little bit scared.

This story was about a girl who loved to climb slides.

Working together helps solve problems more easily.
Looking carefully in different places can help you find what is lost.
